Since the query 'Mahkota' is ambiguous and could refer to any of these distinct locations (or the name itself appears in different contexts like the 'Kembara Mahkota Johor' which has no location answer in the text), all three explicitly stated locations are returned as valid answers corresponding to the specific entities found in the text.
